title: AI Citation Check
description: Stops made-up references going out in AI-written text by flagging the tells with a reason for each (a DOI prefix that doesn't belong to the journal it names, a long dash inside a DOI, a case cited to F.3d for a year after 2021, a year that hasn't happened, leftover oaicite and 【4†source】 markers, long quotes with nothing saying who said them), looking every DOI, case and link up through a pluggable verify such as Crossref or CourtListener, calling anything it couldn't confirm "Unverified" rather than fine, fixing dashes and markers in one tap, and asking for a second press to submit with references that may not exist.
stops: Fake case cited in a court filing
